title: Practice 6: Setting out: пойти, поехать — and сходить, съездить

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Как ___ (съездить — to go and come back (by vehicle); pf., past pl.) в Италию?
exercises.why: **съездили** — past tense (plural) of съездить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: How was your trip to Italy?

exercises.q: ___ (сходить — to go and come back (on foot); pf., imper. sg.) в парикмахерскую.
exercises.why: **сходи** — imperative (ты, singular) of сходить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: Go to the barber.

exercises.q: Она ___ (полететь — to fly off; pf., past f. sg.), как стрела из натянутого лука.
exercises.why: **полетела** — past tense (feminine) of полететь: the perfective of лететь, «set out».
exercises.prompt: She shot off like an arrow from a taut bow.

exercises.q: Я хотел туда ___ (съездить — to go and come back (by vehicle); pf., inf.).
exercises.why: **съездить** — infinitive, the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: I wanted to go there.

exercises.q: Как ___ (съездить — to go and come back (by vehicle); pf., past pl.) в Бостон?
exercises.why: **съездили** — past tense (plural) of съездить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: How was your trip to Boston?

exercises.q: Давай ___ (сходить — to go and come back (on foot); pf., fut. 1st pl.) за раменом.
exercises.why: **сходим** — present tense (1st person plural) of сходить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.
exercises.prompt: Let's go out for some ramen.

exercises.q: ___ (сходить — to go and come back (on foot); pf., imper. pl.) в парикмахерскую.
exercises.why: **сходите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of сходить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: Go to the barbershop.

exercises.q: Ты ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 2nd sg.) сегодня на Копакабану?
exercises.why: **пойдёшь** — future tense (2nd person singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
exercises.prompt: Will you go to Copacabana today?

exercises.q: Как дела? Как ___ (съездить — to go and come back (by vehicle); pf., past m. sg.)?
exercises.why: **съездил** — past tense (masculine) of съездить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: How are you? Did you have a good trip?

exercises.q: Я должен кое-куда ___ (сходить — to go and come back (on foot); pf., inf.).
exercises.why: **сходить** — infinitive, the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: I must go somewhere.

exercises.q: ___ (сходить — to go and come back (on foot); pf., imper. pl.) в погреб за вином.
exercises.why: **сходите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of сходить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: Go down to the cellar and get some wine.

exercises.q: Мы ___ (съездить — to go and come back (by vehicle); pf., past pl.) во Вьетнам.
exercises.why: **съездили** — past tense (plural) of съездить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: We visited Vietnam.

exercises.q: Вы не ___ (поехать — to set off (by vehicle); pf., fut. 2nd pl.) в Боснию в отпуск.
exercises.why: **поедете** — future tense (2nd person plural) of поехать: the perfective of ехать, «set out».
exercises.prompt: You aren't going to Bosnia on vacation.

exercises.q: ___ (сходить — to go and come back (on foot); pf., imper. sg.) в погреб за вином.
exercises.why: **сходи** — imperative (ты, singular) of сходить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: Go down to the cellar and get some wine.

exercises.q: Я хочу ___ (съездить — to go and come back (by vehicle); pf., inf.) на Бали.
exercises.why: **съездить** — infinitive, the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: I want to go to Bali.

exercises.q: Я хочу ___ (съездить — to go and come back (by vehicle); pf., inf.) в Сиэтл.
exercises.why: **съездить** — infinitive, the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: I want to go to Seattle.

exercises.q: Я хочу ___ (съездить — to go and come back (by vehicle); pf., inf.) в Тампу.
exercises.why: **съездить** — infinitive, the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: I want to go to Tampa.

exercises.q: Они ___ (съездить — to go and come back (by vehicle); pf., past pl.) в Беларусь.
exercises.why: **съездили** — past tense (plural) of съездить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: They visited Belarus.

exercises.q: Давай-ка я туда ___ (съездить — to go and come back (by vehicle); pf., fut. 1st sg.).
exercises.why: **съезжу** — future tense (1st person singular) of съездить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: Let me make a trip over there.

exercises.q: Мне нужно ___ (сходить — to go and come back (on foot); pf., inf.) в уборную.
exercises.why: **сходить** — infinitive, the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: I have to go to the toilet.
